body:
Personally I think reading Temporal workflows in PHP are very confusing due to the way you have to yield activities and timers.

Next to that I don't like the fact that I need to use RoadRunner and async PHP only to execute some workflows. 

Recently I implemented an [SDK in PHP  for Absurd durable workflow engine](https://github.com/ruudk/absurd-php-sdk) using [Fibers](https://www.php.net/manual/en/language.fibers.php).

Basically when a workflow wants to suspend execution it triggers Fiber::suspend with the relevant info.

The SDK then reads the value and can decide to resume the Fiber if needed.

Just wanted to share this as I think it's an interesting alternative or a way to simplify the Temporal SDK.

comments.body:
Hi, @ruudk 
Thanks for your thoughts about Temporal and this SDK. SDK for Absurd looks pretty good and also could be improved.

> Personally I think reading Temporal workflows in PHP are very confusing due to the way you have to yield activities and timers.
> ...
> Basically when a workflow wants to suspend execution it triggers Fiber::suspend with the relevant info.
> The SDK then reads the value and can decide to resume the Fiber if needed.

I think Fibers API could be implemented and they even can replace Generators API, but we should decide how to design our API properly.

Imagine, that `Workflow::execute()` returns a Promise which will be passed outside with the `yield` standing before the expression: `yield Workflow::execute()`.
We can omit it and put `Fiber::suspend` inside the `Workflow::execute` function. I suppose that's what you wanted to suggest?
Next, we have `[Workflow::execute(), Workflow::execute(), Workflow::execute()]` which is an array of Promise's.
We also can `yield` them and until they resolved, or use `Promise::any()` and similar wrappers to control the resolving strategy.
How could we replace it with Fibers?

I'd like to ask you to design a public API with the new look. After than we can move further.

> Next to that I don't like the fact that I need to use RoadRunner and async PHP only to execute some workflows.

Ok, don't use? I didn't get this point. Could you please elaborate?

title: Simplify developer experience by replacing yields with Fiber suspension
